title: Global class field theory in Lean 4.35.0-rc2
summary: For every finite abelian extension L/K of number fields, the idèle class group C_K modulo the image of the idèle-class norm from C_L is isomorphic as a topological multiplicative group to Gal(L/K). The Challenge defines the norm as the determinant on the relative adèle algebra and descends it through principal idèles; the included ClassFieldTheory development supplies the proof of the resulting reciprocity theorem.

review.reason: Lean development of global class field theory reciprocity for finite abelian extensions.
